description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractEngine' for a service engine within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles configuration of service locations, manages a dispatcher, and provides mechanisms for sending callback events related to services.

classes.name: AbstractEngine
classes.description: An abstract class for a service engine that manages service location mappings and dispatch callbacks.

methods.name: AbstractEngine
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the engine with a service dispatcher.

methods.name: createLocationMap
methods.description: Creates an immutable map of service location aliases from configuration.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Resolves the actual location of a service, considering aliases.

methods.name: sendCallbacks
methods.description: Overloaded methods that send callback events for a service invocation, with different event data (none, throwable, or result).

methods.name: allowCallbacks
methods.description: Determines if callbacks are permitted for a given service and context.
